title: Monster Speed V3 Step 1 — Workflow Quarantine V2
root_cause: Completed certification workflows remained subscribed to pull_request and/or main push events. Shared entrypoint changes such as app.py could therefore wake frozen historical stacks and consume hosted runners even though their product work was already certified.
patch: Quarantine 16 completed Top Picks and Passing Yards Speed workflows to workflow_dispatch-only without deleting any workflow or job. Add a permanent registry, validator, tests, exact Step-1 workflow, and required DevSystem permanent-gate enforcement.

evidence.cancelled_workflow: Monster Speed V3 Step 1 Workflow Quarantine V2

concurrency_repair.patch: Give the 51-workflow app-fanout guard its own monster-speed-v3-step1-app-fanout concurrency group; retain V2 as the authoritative frozen-workflow quarantine group.
concurrency_repair.retry_policy: This ledger update is the one watched-file trigger for a fresh V2 proof on the final branch head.
